defects_repaired.prior_value: 16 CFR § 23.4 ('Misuse of Gold') & NIST SP 365 wallet card URL
defects_repaired.repaired_value: 16 CFR § 23.3 ('Misrepresentation as to Gold Content') & NIST SP 811 Precious Metals Conversion Information URL
defects_repaired.evidence: Live inspection of eCFR Title 16 Part 23 showed § 23.4 covers Vermeil while § 23.3 governs solid gold / karat thresholds; NIST SP 365 page lacked troy-ounce conversions; the NIST Precious Metals Conversion Information page provides Handbook 130 sec. 2.17 context and links a PDF but does not print the numeric troy-ounce-to-gram constant. The exact 31.1034768 g value is derived from NIST SP 811 Appendix B.9: 480 grains/troy oz × 0.06479891 g/grain.
defects_repaired.evidence_original_preserved: Live inspection of eCFR Title 16 Part 23 showed § 23.4 covers Vermeil while § 23.3 governs solid gold / karat thresholds; NIST SP 365 page lacked troy-ounce conversions whereas NIST Precious Metals Conversion Information explicitly confirms 1 oz t = 31.1034768 g.
